integrity: A self-contained all-dimensional mathematical proof is supplied. Finite exact-integer tests corroborate rather than certify unlimited quantifiers. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Finite directed cycles of length at least four; independently perturbed one-step two-tap probabilities around a common strictly interior center; unweighted complete-pair Gini seminorm. No arbitrary-environment norm or product theorem; historical priority subject to unindexed literature.
title: Sharp robustness radius for heterogeneous cyclic two-tap averaging
